# Kahawa West Community & Business Directory (KWEST)
> Official digital business directory, domestic services index, and emergency hub for Kahawa West, Roysambu Constituency, Nairobi County, Kenya.
> Canonical URL: https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke

## Platform Overview
Kahawa West Directory (KWEST) is a hyper-local community platform connecting residents and visitors to verified neighborhood businesses, artisans (fundis), healthcare providers, grocers, domestic specialists, and official estate services in Kahawa West, Nairobi, Kenya.

- **Location**: Kahawa West Ward, Roysambu Constituency, Nairobi County, Kenya (Postal Code: 00609)
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke
- **Supported Currencies**: KES (Kenyan Shilling)
- **Primary Payment Modes**: Lipa Na M-Pesa (Buy Goods Till, Paybill), Cash
- **Community Helpline & Editorial Desk**: +254 764 405 842

---

## Estate Zones & Sub-Localities
Businesses and public facilities in Kahawa West are categorized across 13 distinct geographical estate zones:
1. **Congo**: Main commercial hub along Congo Road, bustling market stalls, electronic shops, and retail centers.
2. **Roundabout**: Central commuter interchange, matatu stages, chemist hubs, and banking agents.
3. **Jacaranda Estate**: Established residential zone featuring schools, daycare centers, and quiet neighborhood amenities.
4. **Jubilee Estate**: Residential community bordering northern bypass connections.
5. **Northern Bypass**: Highway corridor with fuel stations, auto repair hubs, logistics, and major dining spots.
6. **Kware / Quarry**: Vibrant artisans quarter, hardware supplies, and domestic welding workshops.
7. **Bima Road**: Community artery with clinics, pharmacies, hardware, and salons.
8. **Soweto**: Dense residential pocket with localized fresh produce, salons, and convenience kiosks.
9. **Kamae**: Expansive mixed residential area with garages, car washes, and specialized workshops.
10. **Station / Railway**: Commuter train terminal zone and transit retail stalls.
11. **Mahiga**: Quiet residential avenue with churches, schools, and corner bakeries.
12. **Kamiti Road**: Transit corridor connecting Kahawa West to Zimmerman, Roysambu, and Ruiru.
13. **Kiamumbi Border**: Transition zone between Nairobi County and Kiambu County.

---

## Directory Categories & Service Taxonomy
- **Food & Dining**: Nyama choma grills, bakeries, cafes, local eateries, fast food, milk bars.
- **Healthcare & Chemists**: 24/7 pharmacies, medical centers, dental clinics, optical centers.
- **Domestic Specialists & Fundis**: Plumbers, certified electricians, carpenters, masonry, painters.
- **Groceries & Fresh Produce**: Market grocers, fruit vendors, cereal stores, butchery.
- **Hardware & Construction**: Building supplies, electrical equipment, plumbing fittings, paint dealers.
- **Automotive & Mechanics**: Garages, auto spares, car washes, tyre clinics, breakdown services.
- **Salons, Barbers & Beauty**: Kinyozi, hair stylists, nail bars, cosmetics.
- **Gas & Energy**: 6kg/13kg LPG gas refills, solar fittings, electrical contractors.
- **Professional & Cyber Services**: Cyber cafes, KRA tax agents, printing, legal and accounting.
- **Education & Childcare**: Daycare centers, nursery schools, primary academies.

## Emergency Hotlines & Public Services
- **National Emergency / Police**: 999 / 112 / 911
- **Kahawa West Police Post**: +254 722 000 000 / Kasarani Division
- **Nairobi Fire & Rescue**: +254 20 222 2181 / +254 718 199 999
- **Kenya Red Cross Emergency**: 1199 / +254 703 037 000
- **St. Francis Community Hospital (Kasarani)**: +254 718 969 000
- **Nairobi Water & Sewerage (Githurai/Kahawa Depot)**: +254 717 356 578
- **Kenya Power Emergency Dispatch**: 97771 / +254 703 070 707
